body:
User asked (verbatim):
  there is nother bug i have sessio insdie tabsone and now i say forge tthis login but i am still logged and tab is still tehre in tabsona claldue group

Context:
  Released 0.3.1 (16fac4e) in Store review. Forget with an open tab was changed in c0c6683 to RELEASE the tab (engine/storage.ts releaseTab: clear shim carriers, drop namespaced keys, reload on the normal browser login) rather than close it; the tab-group code (engine/tabgroups.ts) never ungroups.

Acceptance:
  After Forget this login with its tab open, the tab is no longer in the persona (no badge, no title marker), is out of the persona's tab group, and is not signed in as the forgotten login; covered by e2e that fails without the fix.
title: Forget this login leaves the tab signed in and inside the persona's tab group
